body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. The target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, the target cannot make movement Reactions until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Lock - Suppression
rider.html: If the target is Locked, the first time it voluntarily moves before your next turn, you may end Lock to reduce that movement by 1 unit.
